ev.q: In 2012, NIDs were conducted in seven of 10 high-risk countries and five of seven moderate-risk countries
In 2013, NIDs have been conducted or are planned in eight of 10 high-risk countries and all seven moderate-risk countries
Countries were assessed to be at moderate risk based on any of the population immunity risk criteria
This report summarizes steps taken by the GPEI to assess and mitigate the risks

methods_quotes.q: Countries were assessed to be at high risk for outbreaks during 2012–2013 based on proximity to countries where WPV was endemic
Countries were assessed to be at moderate risk based on any of the population immunity risk criteria suggesting vulnerability.
Population immunity is assessed by estimates of vaccination coverage by age 12 months with 3 doses
The quality of AFP surveillance is assessed by the proportion of provinces/states that achieve an annual nonpolio AFP reporting rate
The data for this indicator contain a substantial number of NPAFP cases with missing vaccination history.
